headline: SFG @ LAD matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 4.29 at LAD 5.51, with a projected total of 9.81. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: SFG moved +0.89 runs while LAD moved +0.69, changing the projected margin by +0.19 runs. The projected total climbed +1.58, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +18.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Landen Roupp has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Rafael Devers, Luis Arraez, Kyle Tucker, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Bryce Eldridge, Matt Chapman because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
